results.title: Examples of a good fine-tune? - yl4579/StyleTTS2 Discussion #65
results.snippet: 'Aurora': 50 epochs, joint training after 10, 8 hours single voice, batch size 2, max length 220. 'Chaos': 50 epochs, joint after 10, 10 hours (5h+5h blended). 'Violet Parr': 8 minutes of audio, max_len 270.
results.relevance_note: Confirms the 50-epoch / joint-at-10 pattern recurs across multiple independent community fine-tunes, not just the shipped config_ft.yml default -- strengthens the Key Question 2 finding.

results.title: StyleTTS2 Training from Scratch Notebooks - yl4579/StyleTTS2 Discussion #144
results.snippet: Stage 1: ~150 WAV files, 1000 epochs configured but only first 400 needed (val loss stabilized ~0.38-0.4); better results with 10h audio at 200 epochs. Stage 2: trained to 200 epochs target.
results.relevance_note: Deep-read via fetch. From-scratch stage-1/stage-2 epoch counts on a small (~150-file) corpus -- relevant anchor for Key Question 2's from-scratch scenario, though this discussion gives no decoder-specific guidance.
